root_cause.summary: The surface-rule pronunciation layer used by search/reference outputs was not consumed by the r2 MFA lexicon builder.
root_cause.r2_policy: preserve base Korean MFA dictionary pronunciations and use frozen Jamo G2P 1-best only for OOV
root_cause.effect: A pronunciation correction could appear in CSV/reference outputs while phones_mfa was still aligned from a different r2 pronunciation.

additional_gaps.gap: No single canonical pronunciation-selection table projected to both search outputs and the MFA lexicon.
The adoption validator checked file identity, OOV, spn, and acoustic inventory but not linguistic rule or dictionary agreement.
additional_gaps.resolution: r2 is blocked by config/mfa_pronunciation_release_gate.json; r3 adoption requirements include rule-sensitive decisions and projection identity

additional_gaps.gap: Current runbooks and entry documentation still named r2 as the canonical production input.
additional_gaps.resolution: current runbooks, project state, asset ledger, data layout, and start document updated to the r3 hold

additional_gaps.gap: Human infrastructure gates emphasized file linkage, boundaries, tiers, and search usability rather than exhaustive pronunciation-input validity.
additional_gaps.resolution: reuse prior reviews; add targeted pronunciation regression without repeating broad listening review

additional_gaps.gap: Blindly feeding a rule-respelled Hangul form to Jamo G2P 1-best can introduce arbitrary variants.
additional_gaps.resolution: r3 must select or canonicalize phones against an explicit Roman target; unresolved items remain explicit rather than silently falling back

additional_gaps.gap: A type-level surface-rule audit cannot by itself resolve optional rules, cross-eojeol sandhi, n-insertion, some l-nasalization, or morphology-sensitive readings.
additional_gaps.resolution: r3 retains morphology/POS and explicit unresolved or optional statuses; the 312756 screening candidates are not treated as confirmed speech errors

next_required_work: build the canonical r3 pronunciation-selection table
emit the r3 MFA dictionary only as a verified projection of selected phones
run automatic linguistic coverage and frozen-phone-inventory checks
reuse already-reviewed 2022 IDs and rule-stratified samples for targeted regression
adopt one contract id, reuse only proven-equivalent 2020-2022 adaptation units, realign changed units with checkpoints, and align 2023-2025 once
